11003.name: Ancestral Spore
11003.description:
As the festival commences, the priests scatter spore-laden spices throughout the land.
The Kanamians, after singing and dancing to the point of exhaustion, simply lean against whatever is near or find a quiet place, slipping into dreams.
The spores take effect quietly, drifting through each slumbering mind, weaving the dreams of the Kanamians together.
In these dreams, they meet their ancestors, whisper to all living things, and resonate with another self.

Max Stack: 6

Ist sie nicht in ihrer eigenen Welt versunken? ¿No se había sumergido en su propio mundo? 7015087.description:
Not some grand event.
Just sunlight falling just right, the wind warm and kind, a sudden urge to cross that mountain, and someone to walk beside.
And so, the journey began, not by prophecy nor destiny, but simply with the sound of footsteps that belong to today.

7115138.name: Spring Dawn
7115138.description:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

7125137.name: Spring Dawn
7125137.description:
Feathered blossoms scatter through the jade-bright night, as the cold bites, the moon wanes and rounds. Beyond the curtain, the east wind blows, then falls still again. Fish-and-dragon lantern dances unfold, silks and finery layer upon layer, all signs of a festival in peaceful times.
Pepper-blossom and cypress wine flush the cheeks with red, as old peachwood charms are torn away for new. Who would believe the withered branches already brim with urgent spring? One crisp, sudden sound fills half the window with crimson glow, shaking loose the snow from the treetop tips.

7130284.name: Trickster's Smile
7130284.description:
"I've been watching you."

He jolted awake and upon realizing it was just a dream let out a sigh of relief.
But the voice lingered.

A chill crept up his spine. He looked up—
the trickster's hat that had vanished in a puff of smoke during the show now stood silently by his bedside.
Beneath its brim, a soundless smile slowly unfurled.

The trickster fell silent.

Every step and turn is a stroke upon the canvas of darkness, tracing paths meant only for the stage.
Tonight, the stars wink awake and dreams quietly make their entrance.

Every step and turn is a stroke upon the canvas of darkness, tracing paths meant only for the stage.
Tonight, the stars wink awake and dreams quietly make their entrance.

7230021.name: Starry Night
7230021.description:
As night draws its curtain, starlight softly answers from above.
Every step and turn is a stroke upon the canvas of darkness, tracing paths meant only for the stage.
Tonight, the stars wink awake and dreams quietly make their entrance.

9040081.name: Elder Voidmind's Seal
9040081.description:
Elder Voidmind was the guide of wisdom. He studied ancient scrolls and uncovered many ancestral truths. The Longevity Tree, used as the tribe's council hall, flourished under his care.
However, 7 years ago, Elder Voidmind vanished without a trace...
Rumor says he never truly left, but chose to hide among the tribe, observing the world through mortal eyes.
